title: Print or email a quote
summary: Print the quote or email it to the patient as a PDF.

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Quotes
steps.details: The treatment plan with prices for the patient to approve; once confirmed it's invoiced, booked and charged.

steps.title: Open the quote
steps.details: Tap the quote in the list. The guide continues once its details open.

steps.title: Print
steps.details: Opens the print view with the clinic's format.

steps.title: Recipients
steps.details: The patient's email is filled in; you can add others separated by commas.

steps.title: Send
steps.details: The PDF is attached and it stays in the communication history.
